caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, translucent glass bottle with a narrow neck and no stopper. The bottle is primarily purple in color with subtle highlights and shadows that give it a three-dimensional appearance. The surface of the bottle has a textured, dotted pattern. The bottle is placed on a surface that is shaded in gray and light brown tones, casting a soft shadow to the right. The background is a plain, neutral shade with a slight gradient from top to bottom, enclosed within a light beige or off-white border. The entire composition is centered within a square frame.
title: Bottle
